key_insight: ClinRAG-GRAPH combines MRI, clinical, and biopsy data with graph learning and evidence retrieval to improve pre-treatment breast pCR prediction.
clinical_relevance: If validated, it could help stratify neoadjuvant chemotherapy candidates before treatment and better support cross-center decision-making.
method: Builds an intra-patient clinical-prior graph from DCE-MRI, structured clinical variables, and biopsy biomarkers.
Uses a prior-guided relation-aware GCN plus dual-branch domain-adversarial learning to reduce multicenter MRI bias.
Adds an LLM-driven subgraph RAG module to retrieve clinically similar cases for more interpretable predictions.
evidence_signal: In a multicenter cohort, the model achieved AUC 0.815 on the internal test set and 0.774/0.712 on two external test sets.
watch_item: Performance, while strong, is still lower on external centers, so real-world deployment will need careful prospective validation and protocol harmonization.
paper_title: ClinRAG-GRAPH: Clinical-prior Retrieval-Augmented Graph Model with Domain Adversarial Learning for Breast pCR Prediction
